sentences.en: The view from the Japanese pagoda is breathtaking.
sentences.zh: 从日本塔上看风景非常壮观。

sentences.en: We took our date to the Japanese pagoda for a romantic dinner.
sentences.zh: 我们带她去了日本塔吃浪漫晚餐。

sentences.en: The park has many traditional buildings, including a Japanese pagoda.
sentences.zh: 公园里有许多传统建筑，包括一个日本塔。
